user.title: Toshiba Legacy TV
user.description:
Turn the TV on and enable new device detection in its Apps Control Profile. Enter its IP address or hostname.

For network wake on the TL938 series: Setup → Preferences → Network Device Setup → TV Power On Control → On. Wait at least 10 seconds after entering standby. Active standby uses more power. This setting may also keep USB ports powered: do not enable it if you need USB power to turn off in standby.

The manual describes this option for Wi-Fi; a full standby/wake cycle was also visually confirmed over Ethernet on the 46TL938K (firmware 7.0.28.16.1). Explicit On/Off actions check the current state before sending the toggle. The API must remain reachable in active standby; no Wake-on-LAN packets are sent. Other models still require verification.

Remote keys: CT-90405 profile (TL938 series).

The Remote entity switch controls TV power; it does not disable this integration.

On the tested 46TL938K, Wake-on-LAN attempts with TV Power On Control disabled did not restore network access. Wake with USB power off is therefore not verified.

pin.title: Toshiba pairing
pin.description: Enter the four-digit PIN displayed on the TV ({host}). It expires quickly. To get a new code, select Restart pairing and submit this form.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair the TV again
reauth_confirm.description: Turn the TV on. Continuing will display a new PIN on its screen.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname, without http:// or a path.
error.cannot_connect: The TV did not respond. Check its power, address and network.
error.invalid_pin: Incorrect or expired PIN. Restart pairing to get a new code.
error.pairing_failed: The TV rejected the request. Check new device detection and restart pairing.

abort.unsupported_tv: This TV does not provide the Toshiba IPC v2 PIN pairing API.
abort.wrong_tv: This address belongs to a different television.
